parts.text: Teacher: 'Overall, I disagree, because although Jummah is commanded in 62:9, it replaces Dhuhr, and the daily salah is the pillar every Muslim must keep five times a day.'
Teacher reads the start sentence and points to the plan.

questions.q: Write a one-sentence justified conclusion for Part B.
questions.a: For example: Jummah has special status (62:9), but it replaces Dhuhr and depends on the daily salah, so I disagree that it is more important.
questions.model: Teacher: 'Overall, I disagree, because although Jummah is commanded in 62:9, it replaces Dhuhr, and the daily salah is the pillar every Muslim must keep five times a day.'
